confirmation.summary: COL1A1 mutation on genetic testing, with typical clinical features.
evidence: Genetic testing revealed mutations in COL1A1, confirming the diagnosis of OI Type I

note.text: Since I was a small child, I've broken bones many times, especially in my arms and legs. My bones often ache, and my legs have a curved shape. I'm shorter than most people my age, and the whites of my eyes look unusually blue. My teeth have a brownish color and chip easily. My gums are often swollen and bleed.
note.author: T33 hand-off (assistant-written from the article; not the patient's words)
